name: @pds/advisor-mcp
description: PDS advisor MCP server — wraps the Anthropic advisor_20260301 beta tool with graceful fallback to plain opus.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/server.js').then(async m => { const r = await m.advise('smoke'); if (r.degraded && r.reason.includes('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY')) { console.log('OK: graceful-degrade path works'); process.exit(0); } if (!r.degraded && r.advice) { console.log('OK: live path works'); process.exit(0); } console.error('FAIL: unexpected response'); console.error(JSON.stringify(r)); process.exit(1); })"
